title: Benisim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Benisim is a earth-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (B), Defense (C).

Location: Forgotten Battlefield - merchant Kasumi past the ancient bridge.

sections.title: Is the Benisim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Defense (C). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
